answers: design finding 1: done — Removed the positive obligation from DSFSTG-1's fourth And. Changed from "`pipeline.skip_to_stage` is emitted when `--from-stage` is active; no stage before <s> is dispatched after that event" to "If `pipeline.skip_to_stage` appears in the event log, no stage before <s> emits stage.start after it." RQFROM-2 prohibits the sequence (emit then earlier dispatch); it imposes no obligation that the event must be emitted.

design finding 2: done — Replaced the internal counter reference in DSITER-1's third And with an observable event proxy. Changed from "When _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE is false or unset (fresh run or nested-loop re-entry), the loop starts at iter=1" to "When the cycle orchestrator runs with _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE unset (fresh run or nested-loop re-entry), stage.start is emitted for a member of the first iteration — no prior iterations are skipped." This is directly observable from the event log.

acceptance-gate finding 1: done — Changed DSFSTG-4 from `[code]` back to `[done]`. The base code at `core/pipeline/runner.sh` has the guard (`--from-stage is only valid with --resume`) in `main()` before the auto-resume elif check — confirmed at base-code line 1737, before line 2081. The test passes on base code, so `[done]` is the correct classification. The Gap 12 step remains in the steps block to restore the guard to its pre-branch position (the branch accidentally moved it after auto-resume); the step is a regression fix that preserves the `[done]` property in the finished change. Evidence: `core/pipeline/runner.sh:"--from-stage is only valid with --resume"`.

lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design already addresses this. Gap 11 documents the problem: after `skip_until_stage` is cleared when the from-stage target is found (in both dispatch-unit arms of `main()` in runner.sh), `resume_mode` is immediately also set to `false`. This prevents the resume skip guard (`$resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]`) from activating for all subsequent leaf stages after `<s>`. DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior: stages after `<s>` that are marked complete are still dispatched, and no stage.skip event is emitted for any stage after `<s>`. Finding 31 and the Decision paragraph both document this explicitly. The fix is `[[ -n "$skip_until_stage" ]] && { skip_until_stage=""; resume_mode=false; }` in both arms.
